entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: How are the Phantom Thieves doing?[n]I've been thinking about a lot of[n]different ways to help you out.
entries.uk: Як там Фантомні Злодії?[n]Я обмірковую безліч[n]способів вам допомогти.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: On that note, I have a report[n]to make. Are you free today?
entries.uk: До речі, маю що[n]доповісти. Ти сьогодні вільний?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Was this a bad time?[n]I'll invite you another time.
entries.uk: Я не вчасно?[n]Запрошу тебе іншим разом.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I'll be wandering around Akihabara,[n]so feel free to call out to me!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, are you going to accept Mishima's[n]invitation?
